charts.title: HIP 41378 c: orbits around HIP 41378
charts.description: The orbits of HIP 41378's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HIP 41378 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Grouffal et al. 2026 (2026arXiv260623103G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname GROUFFAL_ET_AL_2026): P 31.70591 d
